# NeuromorphicVisualPipeline

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
An end-to-end processing chain from visual sensor input through spiking encoding and SNN inference to place recognition output, designed for neuromorphic hardware. Demonstrates a complete neuromorphic solution that can be integrated into TCC's topology-centric network for distributed, real-time spatial awareness.
